chunks: But will be roasted in the fire.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be roasted in the fire according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Infitar highlights the intense, consuming nature of Hellfire as a direct consequence of rejecting divine truth, often linked with the concept of 'Jahannam' as a place of purification or permanent abode for disbelievers. It serves as a concise eschatological warning of divine punishment in the Hereafter, emphasizing the physical and spiritual reality of the fire described in both the Quran and Hadith literature.
